messages:
noah: Heads up — spotted a perf regression on the reranker non-chat canary after yesterday's runtime tweak. Throughput down ~25% and p95 latency jumped from ~120ms -> ~280ms over the last 10m. Anyone able to triage? :eyes:

mia: Yep saw that when I ran a perf profile. Kernel selection flipped for a lot of 128/256 token shapes. Profiler shows more `matmul_v2` paths chosen and KV-cache miss rate up. Quick prometheus slice I ran:
```
sum by (kernel_choice) (rate(rerank_requests_total[1m]))
rate(kv_cache_misses_total[1m])
```
results look correlated with the kernel flip.

samir: Found the config diff — commit `3f8a2b4` relaxed the kernel_affinity_threshold from `0.72` -> `0.4`. That change makes the selector prefer the newer matmul implementation more aggressively. I can revert if we want a quick rollback.

jay: For short-term mitigation consider two small routing changes: set `token_budget_target` to 384 for rerank non-chat, and clamp `max_slot_merge=2`. Also enable early-fill prefill for non-latency-sensitive bursts. Quick config sketch:
```yaml
endpoint: rerank-nonchat
token_budget_target: 384
max_slot_merge: 2
prefill: hysteresis=0.15
```
This should reduce fragmentation and KV churn.

li: Ran a 10m probe with token_budget_target=384 + max_slot_merge=2 on a small canary (10% traffic). Observed: p95 -30ms, throughput -6%, `prefill_hits` +18%, `kvcache_evictions` -12%. So latency improved but we lost a bit of raw throughput. Detailed logs: `kvcache_eviction_rate=3.1/s -> 2.7/s`

noah: OK — two short actions: (1) @samir please roll back the affinity_threshold change in canary if you think it's the root, (2) @jay/@li keep the token_budget probe running 30m and capture perf counters. If rollback reduces regression, we'll revert the commit and open a perf follow-up.

samir: Rolling back now on canary. `deploy-bot` will post status.

deploy-bot: rollout started: revert/3f8a2b4 -> canary (10% traffic). CI: green. Notifying monitors.

noah: Great. After rollback we should run a kernel matrix: measure matmul_v1 vs v2 across token shapes [32,64,128,256,512] with current kvcache hit profile. I'll open an eval ticket and assign @mia @li @samir.

mia: +1 — also add a metric for `kernel_choice` churn per-request and KV cache miss delta so we can detect future flips faster.

li: Copy that, will add dashboards and an automated smoke test for rerank non-chat (tight token budgets).

noah: Thanks all — keeping this thread for follow-up notes. :thumbsup:
